events.text: MADISON walks up to her door, arms full of paint supplies and groceries. There's an eviction notice from the City Marshall and a chain and lock on the door.
Shit! I thought I had two more days. Damn it!
Madison drops the supplies on the floor and takes out her cell phone. She makes a call
Jason pick up it's me. Jason come on I need you. I know you're there.
Madison puts away the phone and picks up her supplies.

events.text: Madison struggles to retrieve the keys to Jason's apartment out of her pocket while juggling her supplies. She gets the door open.
As soon as she enters the apartment she hears the unmistakable moans and groans of wild sex coming from the bedroom.

Madison heads back for the door but hesitates. She puts her supplies down quietly and then opens a large can of paint. She walks to the bedroom, flings the door open and throws the paint all over Jason and his lover.
Jason wipes globs of paint from his face.
Madison! Is that you honey, wait I can explain.
Madison beams the empty paint can directly at Jason's head. It hits the mark and knocks Jason out. Madison storms out of the apartment.
